name: Spaghetti Sauce
description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

_similar.name: Mozzarella Spaghetti Skillet
_similar.description: A one-pot spaghetti dish cooked with hamburger, tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: Broken spaghetti to feed your family

recipeInstructions.text: In an electric skillet, brown the hamburger, onion, and green peppers.
Season with Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, water, and broken spaghetti to the skillet.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring frequently to prevent the spaghetti from sticking.
Simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Shortly before serving, add shredded mozzarella cheese and continue heating until melted.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti skillet, one-pot pasta, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

_similar.keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup
